name: Spieljoch
kurzbeschreibung: Spieljoch in Fügen is the premier adventure peak in the Zillertal with a 10-seater gondola to 1,865 m, water adventure park, historic copper mine, and panoramas.
beschreibung:
Überblick

Mount Spieljoch in Fügen is the foremost family and recreational adventure mountain at the threshold of the scenic Zillertal valley in the Tux Prealps. A modern 10-seater monocable gondola carries visitors from the valley base at 640 metres up to the mountain terminal at 1,865 metres in under ten minutes. At the top, passengers are greeted by an expansive panorama taking in the Zillertal Alps, the Kitzbühel Alps, and the broader Inn Valley toward the Karwendel range. Spieljoch has earned acclaim as one of Tyrol's top warm-weather destinations: adjacent to the top terminal, an extensive water play wonderland features rafts, climbing crags, low-ropes obstacle courses, and barefoot sensory trails. Nearby lies the fascinating Öxltal Historic Show Mine perched near 1,800 metres, the oldest documented silver and copper mining site in the Zillertal. In winter, impeccably groomed ski slopes and one of the valley's longest artificial-snow descents draw sports enthusiasts.

Route & Anforderungen

Surrounding the summit station, a web of well-maintained trails caters to all abilities. A prime introductory walk ascends from the lift terminal to the landmark Spieljoch Summit Cross at 1,920 metres (approx. 20 minutes, 60 metres elevation gain), easily tackled by children and casual walkers. More ambitious hikers can pursue the panoramic ridge traverse toward Kellerjoch or undertake the scenic descent via the Geolsalm pasture and the show mine back to the mid-station (approx. 2.5 hours, 600 metres descent). Supportive walking boots with treaded soles are advised for alpine trails. The immediate playpark area at the summit terminal is stroller-accessible.

Besuch & Anreise

The base terminal is situated on the southern outskirts of Fügen, reachable in minutes from the Inntal A12 motorway via the federal Zillertalstraße B169. Free surface parking and garage decks are located at the lift. Rail travelers arrive on the historic Zillertalbahn railway from Jenbach to Fügen-Hart station, continuing via free local shuttle bus.

Tipps

Combine your visit with an underground guided tour through the historic Öxltal show mine, followed by authentic Tyrolean curd fritters ('Zillertaler Krapfen') on the sun-soaked deck of the Mountain Loft restaurant.
preis: Round trip adults approx. €32, child reductions available; historic mine guided tour approx. €12
oeffnungszeiten: Summer lift operations run late May through late October; winter ski season December to April
